purpose: Link channel performance to the exact canonical video and creative recipe without treating popularity as factual truth.

owned_app.text_retention: Comments remain in the moderation store and are not copied into analytics rows.

youtube.method: Authorized YouTube Analytics or Data API for project-owned videos only
youtube.retention: Reconfirm authorization and video existence at least every 30 days.

linkedin.method: Authorized organization or member analytics where the approved API product permits it

separation_rules: Reach, retention and engagement can tune creative selection but cannot validate a product fact.
Reviewer factual and rights decisions remain separate governed objects.
Every metric row identifies the canonical distribution package and platform post ID.
Primitive usage is version-bound to the render recipe.

admission.reason: Enable only after idempotent projection and current cost/query-byte controls are connected.
